text: Implemented pure multivar neuroimaging boundary: SampleByFeatureInput, RoiPlan/RoiPlanSet, MultivarPlan, execution intent, source refs, FitArtifact shapes, and LocalMultivarExecutor for ROI PCA/SVD/Nystrom. multivar remains free of Spark, Breeze, fmri, image, and dataset imports.
